about: LABS-1.064 (semantic decision closure). `blocked`: decisions still open; evaluation/e2/check.py refuses a question that depends on one (H-8 as amended). `unimplemented`: answer paths and parameters whose semantics an approved decision fixes but which no reader provides yet (LABS-1.064 item 19: approval does not establish a capability). A scored (A/H) question may not expect or pass them; a class G probe may, under the DI or gap named. The field names are reserved by the reader contracts (reader-contracts.md 0.11); an implementation increment either uses them or amends the contract. Remove an `unimplemented` entry when its DI is implemented and approved; remove a `blocked` entry when the owner rules on it. Path patterns: a prefix ("alternatives"), "*<field>" for a field anywhere, or "<prefix>*<field>" for a field anywhere below a prefix.
